clips.title: The story
paras: Woodpaw Den is a rugged gnoll stronghold nestled in southern Feralas, just north of the ancient Darkmist Ruins. The settlement serves as a major gathering point for the Woodpaw gnolls and their fiercest pack alphas, making it a dangerous pocket of wilderness within the dense canopy.

Situated amidst the towering boughs of Feralas, Woodpaw Den stands as the fortified heartland of the local Woodpaw gnolls. Unlike smaller scout camps scattered along the jungle tracks, this encampment is heavily guarded by the pack's seasoned Alphas. The gnolls here defend their territory fiercely against both intruding adventurers and the encroaching wilderness. Located just north of the elven remnants at Darkmist Ruins, the den represents an ever-present predatory threat to travelers attempting to traverse the central wilderness of the region.
